speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Skew planes and noncommutative determinants
summary: Skew-plane conventions, scalar elimination, block quasideterminants and Cayley's cube determinant. The homology remark remains a programme. P001477 belongs to the preceding academic-year continuation.

speaker: Gregory Moore
title: Conformal field theory and string backgrounds
summary: Ising theta functions, modular blocks, sewing, mapping-class relations, chiral structures and background equations. Gelfand adds elliptic-function and quantum-space remarks. Normalizations and verification levels are distinguished.

speaker: A. Yu. Morozov
title: String fields, particle paths and worldsheet gravity
summary: The requested string-field action is separated from worldsheet amplitudes and convergent measures. Auxiliary metrics, topology and background equations follow. The cubic/free label and proposed exact auxiliary integral require correction.

speaker: V. A. Kazakov
title: Planar maps and string susceptibility
summary: KPZ susceptibility, pure gravity, a shifted Tutte sequence and graph Gaussian integrals. Rooting, boundary conditions and zero modes matter. Feynman's QED recommendation is a pedagogical preface.

speaker: M. M. Kapranov
title: Exterior modules, projective bundles and quadrics
summary: Despite the D-module heading, the mathematical content is the BGG exterior-module construction and its Clifford/quadric counterpart. The existence theorem is old; the request to avoid derived categories is distinct and not explicitly attributed to I. M. Gelfand.

speaker: A. A. Beilinson; A. A. Kirillov; V. A. Vasiliev; A. B. Goncharov; M. M. Kapranov; A. V. Zelevinsky; I. M. Gelfand
title: Reading curricula for beginners
summary: Seven contributors propose reading plans, not seven undocumented lectures. The cube exercise and Euclidean/symplectic comparison are indexed separately. The heading visibly reads 3/X-88 despite the catalogue qualification that no date is given.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Spin, mass shells and arbitrary-spin mathematics
summary: Gelfand follows a cancelled Morozov heading and precedes Morozov's actual intervention. Mass shells and the SO(3) exercise are classical with corrections; arbitrary-spin mathematics lacks a definite target. Manuscript order places 760 before 759.

speaker: A. Yu. Morozov
title: Planar statistics and Chern--Simons theory
summary: Worldline phases, flux attachment, Hall quasiparticles, an unspecified high-temperature application and Witten's recent Jones work. Spin, exchange and winding conventions require separation. Bare final names establish no additional talk.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Functionals, action amplitudes and quantum mechanics
summary: A hierarchy of functionals, stationary phase, a cubic-phase integral and a request for complementary quantum-mechanical expositions. Precise classical exercises are separated from undefined programmes.

speaker: B. L. Feigin
title: Particle and surface actions, Legendre transformation and transgression
summary: Particle actions and symplectic area lead to Finsler wave fronts, the independent-metric sigma model and a surface Legendre question. The two-connection construction requires explicit pairings, signs and extension hypotheses.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Hyperdeterminants and horizontal-form complexes
summary: The Cayley quartic and weighted regular functions introduce a determinant-complex programme. The suggestion to replace Young diagrams remains underspecified.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Representation theory and determinant constructions
summary: Highest weights, Gauss factorization and Borel--Weil--Bott appear beside odd differential determinants, noncommutative determinants, torsion complexes and hyperdeterminant degrees. The disk-model calculation is separate.

speaker: A. S. Schwarz
title: Chern--Simons theory, torsion and knot observables
summary: The Gaussian/torsion model, nonabelian action, transgression, surgery and Wilson loops. Schwarz 1978 and Witten's July 1988 lecture establish pre-seminar chronology; functional integration and framing remain qualified.

speaker: V. E. Zakharov
title: Clebsch variables and hydrodynamic integral algebras
summary: Matrix and scalar Clebsch constructions yield geometric integrals, a current algebra and an incompleteness obstruction. Quartic Fourier Hamiltonians and formal ratio-multiplier Lax equations follow. The final vector bracket is ambiguous. The matching paper was submitted 2 November 1988.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Duality and hyperdeterminant degree formulas
summary: Projective duality, polarity and cube sections precede Segre degrees. Leshchiner's generating series, Kapranov's positive sum and Zelevinsky's boundary formula have exact 1989 matches. The existence criterion predates the seminar; the alternating sum needs a justified scope restoration.

title: Catalogue year heading: 1989
summary: The year divider is retained without an additional lecture or duplicated occurrence. Linked pages overlap the preceding Gelfand material and the Zelevinsky lecture. All new occurrence identifiers retain academic-year prefix 1988.

speaker: A. V. Zelevinsky
title: Hyperdeterminants, projective duality and Cayley complexes
summary: Segre hypersurface and degree formulas, determinant complexes, Kapranov's differential forms, and homogeneous and toric examples. Two unheaded annotations on P001518 remain unattributed. The manuscript reads 13/II-88; catalogue chronology and the Monday schedule identify 13 February 1989.

speaker: A. A. Beilinson
title: Lusztig's representation-theoretic programme
summary: Four representation-theoretic settings are compared, followed by a rank-one reflection and exact sequence. Categories and equivalence functors are absent. The preceding Vishik programme is not a set of additional delivered talks.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: A line arrangement and an elliptic integral
summary: Six bounded regions for five affine lines are pictured beside a quartic-root elliptic integral. The connecting map is unspecified; no Pascal-type theorem is inserted.

speaker: M. M. Kapranov
title: K3 surfaces, Kummer quotients and quadrics
summary: K3 conditions, common smooth topology and the sixteen-node Kummer construction. Below a separator a Plücker quadric meets another quadric; the manuscript does not identify that threefold as K3.

speaker: V. G. Drinfeld
title: Quasi-Hopf algebras and KZ equations
summary: Associators, pentagon and hexagons, twisting and the regularized KZ transition. Gelfand asks about duality and hypergeometric functions. The matching paper was received 23 May 1989. The visible 15/V-89 corrects the catalogue's 14 May date.

speaker: V. S. Dotsenko
title: Fermionic and surface descriptions of the Ising model
summary: Finite Ising sums lead through contours and Grassmann variables to energy correlations, scaling and a three-dimensional quartic/surface representation. The closing question concerns the continuum limit. The cited 1988 chapter was verified bibliographically; its full coefficients were not obtained. The development supplies preparatory finite checks.
